candidates.overview: We meet the men and women who came face to face with some of the world's most notorious murderers yet escaped with their lives. Featuring extraordinary first-hand testimony from the survivors, alongside commentary from criminologists and…

candidates.overview: The call comes through. Murder. But maybe the caller isn't as innocent as they seem...
